author: CNN
description:
President Donald Trump said Tuesday that the United States is cutting off $4 billion in aid to Israel at the end of the year because “they don’t need it.”

Trump, speaking to Fox News on the morning of Election Day, suggested that US aid to Israel has become a powerful political talking point for Democrats and questioned why Republicans should “suffer the slings” from candidates like Michigan Democratic Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed when Israel isn’t in need of assistance.

“It’s a bad talking point because when you say, ‘Why don’t we give everybody $4 billion?’ Israel’s our number one; we give them more than anybody else, and they no longer need it,” he said.

CNN’s election analysts break down the news & speak to current and former representatives for their reactions.

title: Trump: U.S. will end funding to Israel at end of year

author: CNN
description:
Japanese artist Mariko Mori has spent more than three decades building a diverse body of work that spans everything from photography and computer-generated images to sculpture and large-scale interactive installations. 

Now, a major retrospective exhibition at Tokyo’s Mori Art Museum traces her career through 40 of her most defining works. The exhibition was co-curated by Mori Art Museum Director Mami Kataoka and Alexandra Munroe, Senior Curator at Large, Global Arts, Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum and Foundation, who spoke to CNN about the artist’s legacy. 

The exhibition is part of the citywide events featured during Art Week Tokyo and will be on until late March.
title: How artist Mariko Mori blends technology, science and spirituality in her work

author: CNN
description:
Haley Stevens’ decision Sunday to drop her post-primary endorsement of Abdul El-Sayed and endorse Republican nominee Mike Rogers uncorked simmering Democratic anger at her fiancé, who told reporters he was voting for Rogers days before Stevens did so.

Stevens insists that he had nothing to do with her decision to endorse Rogers. On Monday night, she posted a lengthy statement on X that criticized what she called “sexism dressed up as political analysis.”

CNN’s Anderson Cooper talks to Mallory McMorrow who ran against Stevens and El-Sayed in the primary on Stevens’ about face and the CNN NewsNight panel debates on who this will helps more in the race & the wider implications for 2028.
